points.description: States that the parameters K (storage time constant) and x (weighting factor) are assumed constant, i.e. they do not change with time, but depend on the shape/characteristics of the channel in the reach.
points.partial_credit: Half: states K and x are constant but omits dependence on channel shape (or vice versa), clearly stated.

points.description: States that the relationship between storage and inflow/outflow (outflow vs inflow) is linear, with exponent m = 1 (S = K[xI + (1-x)O]).
points.partial_credit: Half: says relation is linear but does not give m = 1, or gives m = 1 without saying linear.

points.description: States that the method is valid only for channel routing (not reservoir routing), with weighting factor x as stated in the model answer.
points.partial_credit: Half: states channel routing only but no mention of weighting factor x.

rubric.notes: Full marks need K and x constant in time but dependent on channel shape, a linear relation with m = 1, and validity for channel routing only. Vague statements such as "simple method" earn nothing. Any wrong statement within a point (e.g. K or x varying with time, or reservoir routing) means that point earns nothing. Award part marks only where clearly more than half of the point is stated precisely.
